title: The Tooth Fairy
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig, this is my little brother George,
lines.zh: 我是佩奇，这是我的弟弟乔治，

lines.en: this is Mummy Pig, and this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa Pig
The Tooth Fairy
Peppa and George are having their favourite food, spaghetti.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治正在吃他们最喜欢的食物，意大利面。

lines.en: What a lot of noise!
Finished!
Ah, now we'll have a bit of quiet.
What's that?
It's a tooth.
Where did that come from?
Peppa, maybe you should look in the mirror.
lines.zh: 佩奇，也许你应该照照镜子。

lines.en: It's my tooth.
It's fallen out.
Don't worry Peppa, it's just a milk tooth.
lines.zh: 别担心佩奇，这只是一颗乳牙。

lines.en: They're meant to fall out.
Will I grow a new one Mummy?
lines.zh: 我会长出一个新妈妈吗？

lines.en: Yes you will Peppa.
It also means the Tooth Fairy will be paying you a visit.
lines.zh: 也代表牙仙子要来拜访你了。

lines.en: Tooth Fairy?
Yes the Tooth Fairy.
If you put the tooth under your pillow tonight, the Tooth Fairy will come.
lines.zh: 如果你今晚把牙齿放在枕头下，牙仙子就会来。

lines.en: The Tooth Fairy will take the tooth and in its place she will leave a shiny coin.
lines.zh: 牙仙子会拿走牙齿，并在其位置上留下一枚闪亮的硬币。

lines.en: When I grow up I want to be a Tooth Fairy.
lines.zh: 长大后我想成为牙仙子。

lines.en: And what would you like to be when you grow up George?
lines.zh: 乔治，你长大后想做什么？

lines.en: I'm sure.
A dinosaur.
Quick George, it's bedtime.
We don't want to miss the Tooth Fairy.
Before going to bed, Peppa and George brush their teeth.
lines.zh: 睡觉前，佩奇和乔治刷牙。

lines.en: Peppa, what are you doing?
I'm brushing my tooth so it's nice and clean for the Tooth Fairy.
lines.zh: 我正在刷牙，这样对牙仙子来说又干净又漂亮。

lines.en: Peppa cannot wait to get into bed.
lines.zh: 佩奇迫不及待地想上床睡觉。

lines.en: Peppa is putting her tooth under the pillow for the Tooth Fairy.
lines.zh: 佩奇正在把牙齿放在枕头下给牙仙子。

lines.en: Good night Peppa and George.
Good night Mummy.
Good night Daddy.
Good night my little piggies.
George, I'm not going to sleep.
Let's both stay awake all night and see the Tooth Fairy.
lines.zh: 让我们一起彻夜不眠看看牙仙子吧。

lines.en: This Tooth Fairy is very late.
lines.zh: 这个牙仙子来得太晚了。

lines.en: The Tooth Fairy is taking a long time to arrive.
lines.zh: 牙仙子要等很长时间才能到达。

lines.en: Where is that Tooth Fairy?
What is that noise? Is it the Tooth Fairy?
lines.zh: 那是什么噪音？是牙仙子吗？

lines.en: George? Can you hear something?
Oh George.
Oh the noise is George. He was so tired he has fallen asleep.
lines.zh: 哦，噪音是乔治。他太累了，已经睡着了。

lines.en: George is not very good at staying awake.
lines.zh: 乔治不太擅长保持清醒。

lines.en: But I am. I'm going to stay awake and see the Tooth Fairy.
lines.zh: 但我是。我要保持清醒去看看牙仙子。

lines.en: But I'm not going to sleep.
The Tooth Fairy has arrived.
But Peppa is asleep.
Hello Peppa. Would you like this coin in return for your tooth?
lines.zh: 佩奇你好。你想要用这枚硬币来换取你的牙齿吗？

lines.en: What a nice clean tooth. Thank you Peppa. Good night.
lines.zh: 多么干净的牙齿啊。谢谢佩奇。晚安。

lines.en: Peppa, George, wake up. It's morning.
lines.zh: 佩奇，乔治，醒醒。现在是早上。

lines.en: What? I wasn't asleep.
Did the Tooth Fairy come?
No.
Let's take a look under your pillow.
lines.zh: 让我们看看你的枕头底下。

lines.en: Look Peppa. The Tooth Fairy has been and she's left you a coin.
lines.zh: 看佩奇。牙仙子已经来了，她给你留了一枚硬币。

lines.en: Hooray!
You fell asleep, didn't you?
Well, maybe I fell asleep just for a little bit.
lines.zh: 好吧，也许我只是睡了一会儿。

lines.en: Next time I will stay awake and I will see the Tooth Fairy.
lines.zh: 下次我会保持清醒，我会看到牙仙子。

lines.en: George, I'll pick up the sticks and you can carry them.
lines.zh: 乔治，我把棍子捡起来，你拿着。

lines.en: Collecting sticks is fun.
